questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer p, q, r
Set p = 12, q = 25
Set r = (p & q) + (p ^ q)
Print r
questions.explanation: Bitwise AND (12 & 25) = 8. Bitwise XOR (12 ^ 25) = 21. (Note that (A & B) + (A ^ B) = A | B in Boolean algebra arithmetic). Total = 8 + 21 = 29.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer p, q, val
Set p = 15, q = 23
Set val = (p | q) - (p & q)
Print val
questions.explanation: (p | q) = 31. (p & q) = 7. val = 31 - 7 = 24. (Notice (A | B) - (A & B) is mathematically identical to A ^ B).

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer p, ans
Set p = 18
Set ans = (p & 7) << 2
Print ans
questions.explanation: (p & 7) masks the lowest 3 bits of 18, yielding 2. Left shifting by 2 multiplies by 4: 2 << 2 = 8.
